name: image-agent
description: LessonCope — type a subject and topic, get a finished, illustrated PowerPoint.

scripts.caption: node caption-library.js
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:html: node scripts/check-html-scripts.mjs public/index.html public/assignment.html public/join.html public/my-work.html public/oauth-consent.html public/play.html public/start.html practice.html practice-teacher.html
scripts.check:server: for f in *.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run check:server && npm run check:html
